name: Cold Gecko 57
author: Pradeepsaranbishnoi
description: Pill green toggle switch that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: Clicking it toggles it: background-color changes from #2c2 to #c22, box-shadow becomes inset 0 -5px 25px #500, 0 10px 20px #000000, left becomes calc( 100% - 35px ).
